edits.old: Then no rule is evaluated, nothing changes and no decision record is written
edits.new:
Then no rule is evaluated, nothing changes and no decision record is written

  Scenario: AC16 A call to an unknown firm or a case outside its state is answered with an error and writes nothing (X4)
    Given the rwb-partner contract mock returns no firm LF-2026-0009 in the caller's scope
    When the firm-instruction step reads the firm
    Then the read is answered with 404 or 409 as section 5 X4 states
    Then the step stops and nothing is written
    Then the answer to a call without a valid credential is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S4-E5009-APP-AC8)
    Then the answer to a role without the Litigation right is refused with MSG-P4-002 as in AC5

  Scenario: AC17 A replay of a write with the same idempotency key returns the first answer and writes nothing again (BR7)
    Given a write of the firm-instruction step was made with an idempotency key and its answer is stored
    When the same write is replayed with the same idempotency key
    Then the stored answer is returned
    Then no decision record, no instruction request, no clock and no case answer is made again
